## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were written first and cover the new behaviour.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make types`, `make arch` and `make test` pass locally.
- [ ] Relevant integration or end-to-end tests pass (if the change touches Docker services).
- [ ] Documentation and the changelog were updated when behaviour changed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or absolute local paths are included.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and contain no AI attribution.
